$comment: Retained expected merge-enforcement rule for issue #3004 (Implementation sequence section 11, step 5). The required context is the OBSERVED check-run name (check 'merge-compile', app 'github-actions'), never the workflow display name. Compared against live state by scripts/verify-branch-protection.py.
$app_comment: required_check_app_id is the GitHub Actions app id observed on the emitted check run (app slug 'github-actions'). It is part of the requirement, not decoration: a context-only requirement can be satisfied by ANY app posting that name, so the readback reports BP-APP-UNBOUND / BP-APP-MISMATCH when the live rule is not bound to this app.
$emitter_comment: The retained context must still be emitted by this checked-in workflow. The readback parses its job ids and reports BP-RULE-UNBOUND if the rule drifts from its emitter, so a renamed job cannot leave a stale rule that only ever compares as a mismatch.
